method: EXPLAIN ANALYZE server execution time; 120 samples per arm; paired alternating blocks, warm cache, same saved paid order and identical verified payload/fanout. All changes rolled back.
limits: Uncontended local execution, not whole-server CPU or full checkout latency. Worker SQL comparison excludes Auth refresh and network. Ordinary host background load uncontrolled.

decision.producer: Candidate reverted: no measurable speedup (roughly 0.17 ms for one matching recipient). Production producer remains the original implementation.
decision.worker: Adopted: remove redundant per-tick purge and skip inactive/expired subscriptions before backend Auth or SQL. Retention has one authority: the existing cron job.
decision.cleanup: Temporary candidate/baseline SQL copies and comparison harness removed after the experiment. Raw measurements retained; no runtime alternative remains.
